title: MINI TUBES
description: The d-vac mini tubes consist of a tube with capillary and/or a funnel so as to be used as a system. The capillary and funnel are used to transfer the blood to the tube. D-vac mini tubes are available with color coded caps for easy identification according to CLSI coding recommendations. The d-vac mini tubes are made of plastic and contain additive in varying concentrations. Additive choice depends on the analytical test method tested. The manufacturer of the test reagents and/or instrument on which the test is performed, provides these specifications. The mini tubes are also available as 13×75, which is easier centrifuge.

title: SKIN STAPLERS

Stapling is much faster than suturing by hand and also more accurate and consistent. The d-tek skin stapler avoids, effectively, iatric cross-in-fections Skin Stapler are usually applied using a disposable stapler and removed with specilized stapler remover.
